## Business Logic Flows Identified

### 1. 🛒 Order Processing Flow

**Criticality**: HIGH  
**Entry Point**: `ProcessOrder(ctx context.Context, order Order)`

#### Flow Diagram
```
ProcessOrder
├── validateOrder (span)
├── checkInventoryAvailability (span)
│   └── inventory.GetStock (external call)
├── processPayment (span)
│   ├── calculateProcessingFees
│   └── gateway.Charge (external call)
├── updateInventory (span)
│   └── inventory.DeductStock (external call)
└── sendOrderConfirmation (async span)
    └── notifier.Send (external call)
```

#### Instrumentation Details
- **Main span**: `ProcessOrder` with order context
- **Child spans**: 5 (validation, inventory check, payment, inventory update, notification)
- **Key attributes**:
  - `order.id`: Order identifier
  - `order.total`: Transaction amount
  - `order.items_count`: Number of items
  - `payment.method`: Payment type
  - `user.id`: Customer identifier

#### Business Events Captured
- `order.validated`: When order passes business rules
- `inventory.checked`: Availability confirmation
- `payment.processed`: Successful charge
- `order.completed`: Full transaction success
